renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: I, mine, this, that — all the doings of being sure: make the mind supportless and it walks to calm, by picturing's pull. The lasting, the everywhere, the propless, the lord of all — picture words moment by moment, aimed at their meaning: done.

Unreal, Indra's net-shine, all standing up — then ask what the net is made real by: held firm, calm walks. The self never wobbles — so where is knowing, where is doing? The outer states lean on knowing — and this world is open.

No chains of mine, no freedom either — and the scared one's frights: just mind-pictures mirrored in water, the sun's. All sense-doors met — joy, pain, all of it — then leave the senses: self-settled, settled in the self you are.

Knowing lights up all, and all lights the self: one out of one-nature — knowing and known pictured as one seeing. Mind-stuff, knowing, power, self, mind — the fourfold: when it is fully wasted, dear one — then Bhairava-form.

A hundred waveless teachings told short, plus twelve — which knowing, O goddess: the knowing one, the knowing person. Yoked right here: he IS Bhairava — by his speech he does deeds, cursing and blessing both.

paragraphs.text: I, mine, this, that — certainty's crafts: cut the mind's supports and it walks to calm on picturing's pull. Permanent, omnipresent, propless, lord-of-all — words meditated tick by tick, meaning-locked: done.

Unreal, Indra-net glitter, all standing — so what is the net actually real with: locked firm, calm walks. Self unwobbled — knowing where, doing where? Outer states run on knowing-juice — and this world is open.
No chains on me, no freedom either — scaredy frights: mind-pics in water, courtesy of the sun. Every sense-door walked through — highs, lows, the set — then ditch the senses: self-seated in self.
Knowing lights all, all lights self: one from one-nature — knower and known, one feed. Mind, knowing, power, self, mind — the big four: fully wasted, dear one — Bhairava-form unlocks.
Hundred waveless teachings in brief, plus twelve — which knowing, goddess: the knower, the person. Yoked right here: straight-up Bhairava — speech that does stuff, curses and favors both.
